entries.text: A TPC-DS run that executes the power, throughput and maintenance phases together now follows TPC-DS 4.0.0 clause 7.4.2 (load, power, throughput 1, maintenance 1, throughput 2, maintenance 2) and reports QphDS@Size from the specification formula in `summary.tpc_metrics.qphds_at_size`.
details: QphDS@Size = floor(SF x Q / (T_PT x T_TT x T_DM x T_LD)^(1/4)) with Q = 99 x S, T_PT = T_Power x S, T_TT = TT1 + TT2, T_DM = DM1 + DM2 and T_LD = 0.01 x S x T_load, all in decimal hours; the terms are exported as `qphds_terms`.

Throughput Test 1 runs streams 1 to S and Throughput Test 2 runs streams S+1 to 2S; each maintenance test runs S/2 refresh runs on consecutive refresh sets. The second tests are exported as `throughput_test_2` and `maintenance_test_2` phases.

The metric is exported only when every input is valid: official compliance class, an even stream count of at least 4, all 99 power queries, two successful throughput and two successful maintenance tests, and a database load measured in the same run. Otherwise `qphds_unavailable` lists the reasons.
